messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - service=db-connections (redis/postgres) fired for team 'inference-runtime' - urgency: high - PagerDuty incident ID PD-8672. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Alert sent to on-call Alex G (primary) and Samir K (secondary).
Alex G: acked via PagerDuty :white_check_mark:
Alex G: I'm on it, joining channel. seeing spikes in redis 'connected_clients' and pg waiting queries.
Maria T: pinged - I can help with quick mitigation (cache ttl relax, reduce writes).
Samir K: I'm pulling logs now, saw a spike at 22:14 UTC correlated with a large batch job.
Lee H: TL;DR customer impact?
Nora S (support): Some customers reporting search errors and increased latencies, ~12% 5xx rate on search endpoints. CS triaging.
Alex G: quick checks: `redis-cli INFO clients | grep connected_clients` -> 987/1000 (maxclients 1000) (eviction spikes).
Alex G: psql: `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';` -> 420 active, max_conns 500, pgbouncer pooled clients saturated.
Samir K: adding stats dump:
```
# pgbouncer stats
cl_active: 480
cl_waiting: 120
sv_active: 450
sv_idle: 30
```
Samir K: redis slowlog shows a lot of large ZRANGE operations and occasional `LRANGE` with big payloads.
Maria T: Can we temporarily reduce traffic to the cluster? route /search to fallback read-only replica or return cached responses?
Alex G: Yes, we have routing policy `route/critical-first` — I can add a quick rule to throttle search non-authenticated traffic.
Lee H: Suggestation: flip read-only mode for low-tier customers and enable 503 fast-fail for heavy ad-hoc queries. minimizes DB pressure.
Nora S (support): I'll prepare a short customer-facing note: "We're investigating intermittent search errors, working on mitigation; some queries may be delayed"
Samir K: Temp mitigation steps I can run now: 1) increase pgbouncer `max_client_conn` by 200, 2) enable connection_limiter in app to cap per-process conns, 3) restart a few worker pods gracefully.
Alex G: Do the pgbouncer bump and app limiter, Samir. I'll disable a few noisy batch jobs.
Samir K: Running command: `kubectl exec -it pgbouncer-0 -- psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_client_conn = '700'"` (simulated)
Samir K: Also `echo 'SET server_lifetime = 600;' > /etc/pgbouncer/conf.d/tmp && kubectl rollout restart statefulset/pgbouncer`
Maria T: I'll push `X-Search-Throttle: 1` via edge rule for 10 minutes. Pushing now.
Alex G: Noticed immediate drop in cl_waiting from 120 -> 40 in ~30s. Good sign.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-8672 acknowledged by Alex G. Auto-escalation cancelled.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Incident assigned to Alex G, priority P1.
Lee H: Any risk from bumping pgbouncer max? socket limits on host? keep an eye on `ulimit -n`.
Samir K: checked — hosts have headroom. monitoring dashboards green for file descriptors.
Alex G: Next: reduce redis client load: Maria, can you add a temporary `LRU` eviction policy and increase `maxmemory` soft threshold?
Maria T: applied `maxmemory-policy volatile-lru`, bumped `maxmemory` by 10% on staging and rolling to prod.
Samir K: Redis connected_clients down to 650 after evictions and throttle. latency P50 back to normal, P95 improving.
Nora S (support): CS update: number of affected customers reduced to 4 out of 1200. tickets opened, working on messages.
Alex G: Good. Let's keep mitigations for 20m and watch. I'll start a playbook for post-incident root cause.
Maria T: Logging the cause: sudden batch job that wasn't rate-limited hitting heavy multi-key reads on Redis and many long-lived PG conns. Need better backpressure.
Alex G: Assigning follow-ups: (1) add connection backpressure in batch job (Samir), (2) add circuit-breaker at edge for large queries (Maria), (3) improve pgbouncer pooling metrics and alerting (Lee).
Samir K: I'll create the PR for job rate limit and a quick test in staging. ETA ~3h.
Lee H: I'll open an alert refinement ticket — current threshold was too low/noise at 80% queue depth.
Nora S (support): Notifying SL owners of affected customers + giving ETA for next update in 30m.
Alex G: Handoff plan: I'm about to be out for a quick break, Samir you take primary for the next 30m. If anything worsens -> escalate to infra lead @Lee H.
Samir K: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and post updates.
Alex G: Thanks — leaving monitoring channel to Samir.
Samir K: noted. will keep watchers updated.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-8672 status: acknowledged -> resolved (manual).
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-8672 resolved by Alex G.
Nora S (support): Customer update sent: "Issue mitigated; monitoring. We'll follow up with RCA"
Alex G: Postmortem owners: Samir (tech lead), Maria (edge/routing), Lee (alerts). I'll draft incident timeline.
Maria T: adding a quick eval: consider KV cache partitioning and request size limit to avoid large ZRANGE blasts.
Samir K: noted. I'll add to backlog.
Lee H: thumbs up. closing channel unless any other flags.
Nora S (support): closing for now, will reopen if customers report regressions. :white_check_mark:
